Name: Compute features handles missing close prices
Description: compute_features should handle missing close prices.

Name: Profit calculation is correct
Description:
Verifies profit calculation: Target - Entry
    Used to show expected profit in rupees for each signal.

Name: EMA returns correct length
Description: EMA should return same length as input.

Name: Feature values are within expected ranges
Description:
Validates that all computed features are within valid ranges.
    Out-of-range values indicate calculation errors.

Name: BUY signal LOSS when low <= stop
Description:
Verifies BUY signal LOSS condition: price hits stop-loss.
    This is the loss-limiting mechanism for BUY signals.

Name: Pattern boost stays within bounds
Description:
Verifies pattern boost keeps probability between 0 and 1.
    Critical for preventing invalid probability values.

Name: BUY signal WIN when high >= target
Description:
Verifies BUY signal WIN condition: price reaches target.
    This is the profitable outcome for BUY signals.

Name: EMA handles short series
Description: EMA should handle series shorter than period.

Name: Compute features handles non-numeric data
Description: compute_features should handle non-numeric data in close column.

Name: Features handle single valid row after dropna
Description: Features should handle case where only one row remains after dropna.

Name: RSI with custom period
Description: RSI should work with different period values.

Name: Trend direction matches moving average relationship
Description: Trend direction should be 1 when fast MA > slow MA.

Name: ATR handles zero volatility
Description: ATR should handle zero volatility (flat prices).

Name: ATR returns non-negative values
Description: ATR should never be negative.

Name: Verdict is TRADE when probability >= 65%
Description:
Verifies the critical 65% threshold for TRADE verdict.
    This threshold determines whether a signal is actionable.

Name: RSI returns values between 0 and 100
Description:
Verifies that RSI calculation always produces values within the valid range of 0-100.
    
    This is critical because:
    - RSI values outside this range indicate calculation errors
    - Trading decisions depend on accurate RSI values
    - Invalid RSI could lead to incorrect signals
    
    Test validates:
    - All RSI values are >= 0
    - All RSI values are <= 100
    - No NaN values in output (after initial period)

Name: ATR handles missing columns gracefully
Description: ATR should handle missing required columns.

Name: SELL signal LOSS when high >= stop
Description: SELL signal should LOSS when price hits stop.

Name: RSI handles series with NaN values
Description: RSI should handle NaN values in the series.

Name: Handle empty patterns list
Description: Scanner should handle empty patterns list (no SimpleMem data yet).

Name: Compute features handles insufficient data
Description: compute_features should handle insufficient data gracefully.

Name: Signal with no outcome remains pending
Description: Signal should remain pending if neither target nor stop is hit.

Name: SELL signal WIN when low <= target
Description: SELL signal should WIN when price hits target.

Name: Confidence is High when probability >= 70%
Description:
Verifies the 70% threshold for High confidence classification.
    High confidence signals are prioritized for trading.

Name: RSI handles empty series gracefully
Description: RSI should handle empty series without crashing.

Name: RSI handles flat prices correctly
Description:
Verifies RSI behavior when prices don't move (flat market).
    
    Expected behavior:
    - RSI should return 50 (neutral) for flat prices
    - This indicates no momentum in either direction
    
    Why this matters:
    - Flat prices mean no gains or losses
    - RSI should reflect neutral market condition
    - Prevents false signals in sideways markets

Name: EMA converges to price for flat series
Description: EMA should converge to price level for flat prices.

Name: RSI handles volatile prices
Description:
Verifies RSI handles extreme price volatility without errors.
    Tests with rapidly changing prices to ensure calculation stability.

Name: Compute features returns all required fields
Description:
Verifies that compute_features returns all required fields for ML model input.
    Missing fields would cause model prediction to fail.

Name: Pattern boost calculation with insufficient samples
Description: Pattern boost should not apply with < 10 samples.

Name: ATR with custom period
Description: ATR should work with different period values.

Name: Signal evaluation handles both target and stop hit
Description: When both target and stop are hit, first check wins (target priority).

Name: Features handle extreme volatility
Description: Features should handle extreme price swings.

Name: RSI zone mapping is correct
Description:
Verifies RSI zone mapping:
    - Zone 0: RSI < 30 (oversold)
    - Zone 1: 30 ≤ RSI < 50 (weak)
    - Zone 2: 50 ≤ RSI < 70 (strong)
    - Zone 3: RSI ≥ 70 (overbought)

Name: Handle missing CSV file gracefully
Description: Scanner should handle missing CSV files gracefully.
